character: Unique 'snail' shaped opening corner sequence with a very long back straight. Wide, sweeping corners test a car's mid-corner balance and aero efficiency.

corners.name: Turn 1-2
corners.technique: Constant-radius-tightening corner — carry patience, keep tightening the line, don't apex too early
corners.trap: Early apex on the first part leaves the car with nowhere to go as the corner keeps tightening

corners.name: Turn 5-6
corners.technique: Commit with minimal lift, smooth steering through the direction change
corners.trap: Lifting unnecessarily through the high-speed section

corners.name: Turn 11-13
corners.type: increasing-radius spiral (the second 'snail'), feeding a 1.2km straight
corners.technique: Progressive throttle as the radius opens through the sequence, prioritise exit traction out of T13 — feeds the longest straight on the lap
corners.trap: Getting on power too early mid-spiral costs the exit onto the long straight after T13

corners.name: Turn 14
corners.technique: Late apex, clean exit onto the pit straight
corners.trap: Compromised exit costs time all the way to the line
